# Setup Org Hierarchy - WxEngage standalone

Source: https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/setup-org-hierarchy
Documentation version: 6.20.0
Retrieved: 2026-09-08T23:29:25+00:00

Webex Engage allows your tenant to be further segmented into Groups and Teams. Groups represent geographical locations (For example, the Americas, UK, APJC, etc.) or various business groups within a conglomerate / multi-brand business. Under a Group, you can create Teams representing a collection of people working together in a particular function (For example, Sales, Support, etc.)

While most contact centers may choose to configure an elaborate Org structure, all Engage tenants are primed within a ‘Default group’ and a ‘Default team’ within it to get you started quickly. More details on this can be found in the [Engage User guide](https://docs.imi.chat/docs/platform-structure-and-user-roles).
